facts.text: Deborah visited a place that holds a lot of memories for her, specifically her mother's old house.

evidence.quote: Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.

facts.text: Deborah's mother passed away a few years ago, and the house holds memories of their time together.

evidence.quote: It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago.

facts.text: Deborah shared a photo of her and her mother, both in wheelchairs, hugging together.

evidence.quote: This is our last photo together. [image: a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair]
